answer: In a decentralized AI economy, a Sybil resistance mechanism utilizing a digital reputation system can mitigate fake-identity attacks. Each agent is assigned a unique reputation score, serving as an anchor for its identity. When an agent is maliciously duplicated, its reputation score is rapidly drained, causing a ripple effect that notifies the network. If an attacker attempts to create a large number of fake identities, it will inevitably exhaust its reputation in a canyon of worthless transactions, rendering the fake identities useless.
